title: King's Indian Defence
intro: Against 1.d4: let White build a big centre, castle quickly, then attack it. A fighting choice for Black.

lessons.title: The King's Indian set-up
lessons.summary: Fianchetto, castle, then strike at the centre.

steps.text: White opens with 1.d4. In the King's Indian, Black does not fight for the centre at once. First the king gets safe; then Black strikes back.

steps.hint: The knight goes to its best square, f6.

steps.text: Prepare a fianchetto: make room for your bishop on g7.
Put the bishop on its long diagonal.
steps.ifRight: From g7 the bishop aims through the centre.

steps.text: White builds a big centre with 4.e4.
Play d6: it stops e5 and prepares your own ...e5 later.
White played 5.Nf3. Get your king to safety before you fight.
steps.hint: The squares between your king and the h8 rook are empty.
steps.ifWrong: Castle first; the counterattack with ...e5 comes next.
steps.ifRight: Castled. Now Black hits the centre with ...e5 or ...c5.

lessons.title: The kingside pawn storm
lessons.summary: When White closes the centre with d5, reroute to e7 and strike with ...f5.

steps.text: When White locks the centre with 8.d5, the pawn chain points towards the kingside. Black attacks on the kingside while White pushes c5 on the queenside.
Move your c6 knight out of the way and towards the kingside.
steps.ifWrong: Play 8...Ne7 so your knight helps defend and supports ...f5.
steps.ifRight: From e7 the knight eyes g6 and leaves the f-file clear.

steps.text: White starts rerouting the knight to d3 with 9.Ne1.
Clear the path for your f-pawn.
steps.hint: Step back with the f6 knight to d7.
steps.ifWrong: Play 9...Nd7 so ...f5 is ready next move.
steps.ifRight: The f-pawn is ready to storm forward.

steps.text: White puts the knight on d3: 10.Nd3, preparing c5.

steps.ifWrong: Play 10...f5 to attack e4 and start the kingside pawn storm.
steps.ifRight: Black takes the initiative on the kingside, aiming for ...f4 and ...g5.

steps.text: White reinforced e4 with 11.f3. Gain kingside space or bring the d7 knight back into the attack.
steps.hint: Push ...f4 to gain kingside space, or put a knight back on f6.
steps.ifWrong: Play 11...f4 (or 11...Nf6) to build up the kingside pawn storm with ...g5 and ...h5.
steps.ifRight: Black's pawns roll forward with ...g5, ...h5 and ...Rf6-g6.
